title: eriogonum thornei
intro: Eriogonum thornei, commonly known as Thorne's Buckwheat, is a perennial shrub in the buckwheat family, characterized by its small white flowers and silvery-green foliage. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Eriogonum thornei include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as hypertension and atherosclerosis. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
